value.description: Replacement value as ordinary text; empty text requests an empty value when permitted. ENUMERATED must match a choice, HTML_LINK must be a valid URL, DATE syntax remains provider-defined, and PASSWORD is sensitive. Null and omission are not clearing operations.

deviceId.description: Device whose existing custom-property value to replace.

propertyId.description: Existing custom-property identifier associated with the device.

FunctionInput_nable_ncentral_updatedevic.description: Target device custom property and its replacement text value.

updated.description: The provider reported that the value update succeeded; not a read-back of the stored value.

items.description: A warning supplied by the provider about the update.

warnings.description: Provider warnings returned with the update; [] when none are supplied.

FunctionOutput_nable_ncentral_updatedevi.description: Provider acknowledgement of the value replacement and any warnings.

tags.instructions: Get propertyId, type, and any allowed choices from `list-device-custom-properties` or `get-device-custom-property`. Supply the new value, not a whole property definition. This overwrites the value; use empty text only when the property's type permits clearing. Do not replay masked password output as a secret.

functions.name: update-device-maintenance-window
functions.description: Partially modify the schedule, activation, duration, or display name of one existing device maintenance window. Request-field mapping is provisional for this documented update capability.

cron.description: Replacement provider cron expression in the existing scheduling context.

name.description: Replacement display name; blank names are not supported by this contract.

durationMinutes.description: Replacement duration in minutes; unit mapping is provisional.

changes.description: Partial window edits; omitted settings must be preserved and null is not accepted.

deviceId.description: Device whose current window is inspected to preserve omitted settings.

scheduleId.description: Opaque decimal schedule identifier, representable as int32.

FunctionInput_nable_ncentral_updatedevic.description: Identify an existing device maintenance window and supply only the settings to change.

success.description: Aggregate update acknowledgment, not a returned updated schedule.

tags.instructions: Get scheduleId from `list-device-maintenance-windows`. Only supplied changes are intended to change; this does not create another window. Use `batch-update-device-maintenance-windows` for several schedules. Editing scheduling can alter future maintenance behavior. Check the window after an ambiguous result.

functions.name: update-organization-unit-custom-property
functions.description: Replace one existing organization unit's current custom-property value without changing its definition or defaults.

value.description: Replacement value as ordinary text. Empty text requests clearing where permitted; omission and null are not clearing operations. ENUMERATED must match an allowed choice, HTML_LINK must be a valid URL, DATE syntax is provider-defined, and PASSWORD is sensitive.

orgUnitId.description: Opaque decimal organization-unit identifier whose current property value to change.

propertyId.description: Opaque decimal identifier of the existing custom property.

FunctionInput_nable_ncentral_updateorgan.description: The existing organization-unit property and its replacement current value.

updated.description: The provider reported success; this is not a read-back of the value.

items.description: A provider update warning, preserved verbatim.

warnings.description: Provider update warnings, or [] when none are supplied.

FunctionOutput_nable_ncentral_updateorga.description: Provider acknowledgment of the current-value update and any update warnings.

tags.instructions: Get propertyId and valid choices from `list-organization-unit-custom-properties` or `get-organization-unit-custom-property`. This overwrites the current value only. Use `update-organization-unit-custom-property-default` to change defaults or propagation. Do not submit a masked PASSWORD result as a new secret.

functions.name: update-organization-unit-custom-property-default
functions.description: Partially modify an existing custom property's default configuration, applicability, and propagation rules at an organization unit. Requires configuration-write authority and can overwrite values across child organizations when propagation is requested.

name.description: Replacement property name; empty text is sent explicitly and may be rejected by the provider.

defaultValue.description: Replacement default value; empty text requests an empty default if allowed. DATE syntax remains provider-defined; PASSWORD content is sensitive.

allowedValues.description: Replacement complete list of allowed ENUMERATED choices. [] requests an empty choice list, subject to provider validation.

items.description: An allowed ENUMERATED choice.

propagationType.description: Replacement provider propagation rule. Exact codes preserve all documented hierarchy distinctions; applicability of individual codes depends on the property level.

selectedOrgUnitIds.description: Replacement complete applicability list, including the home unit and intended children. [] explicitly requests an empty list, subject to provider rules.

items.description: An applicable organization unit identifier.

changes.description: Fields to change; omitted fields retain their current settings. Null is not a clearing operation.

orgUnitId.description: Organization unit at which to update the existing default configuration.

propagate.description: Whether to apply this update's changes to child organization units now under the resulting propagation rule; defaults to false and is not a confirmation gate.

FunctionInput_nable_ncentral_updateorgan.description: Partial changes to an existing organization-unit custom-property default and an optional immediate propagation request.

updated.description: The provider reported successful configuration update; does not establish per-child propagation completion or atomicity.

FunctionOutput_nable_ncentral_updateorga.description: Acknowledgment of the configuration update, not of downstream propagation completion.

tags.instructions: Read `get-organization-unit-custom-property-default` first to inspect the home unit, applicability and propagation rule. Supply only changes, plus whether to propagate this update now. Arrays replace the complete corresponding lists, not individual memberships. Propagation can overwrite child values and is not promised atomic or automatically reversible. Use `update-organization-unit-custom-property` for one current value instead.

functions.name: validate-api-access
functions.description: Check whether N-central accepts the connection's current API access token.

FunctionInput_nable_ncentral_validateapi.description: Validate API access using the current connection; no input is required.

valid.description: True when the provider successfully validates the current connection access token; failures are errors, not false results.

message.description: Provider validation message, omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_nable_ncentral_validateap.description: Successful validation of the current connection API access token.

tags.instructions: Use to diagnose API access, without obtaining or exposing tokens. Use `get-server-health` to check availability independently of protected access. Successful validation does not prove permission to every resource.

functions.name: validate-tigerpaw-credentials
functions.description: Check credentials for the TigerPaw 3.0 standard PSA integration without configuring it. The preview provider operation supports only this PSA type.

password.description: Sensitive TigerPaw PSA password to validate; never returned.

FunctionInput_nable_ncentral_validatetig.description: External TigerPaw PSA credentials to validate without saving integration settings.

valid.description: Whether N-central reports the supplied TigerPaw credentials as valid; false is a normal validation result.

FunctionOutput_nable_ncentral_validateti.description: The credential-validation result reported by N-central.

tags.instructions: Use to test TigerPaw PSA credentials, not N-central connection credentials. This operation is not supported for other standard or custom PSAs. It returns whether the credentials validate; it does not save or replace integration settings. Supply the external PSA username and password.
